prompt: Elements `[95, 85, 75, 65, 55, 45, 35]` are placed into an array and converted into a Min-Heap using Floyd's bottom-up buildHeap algorithm. Which array representation satisfies the min-heap parent-child invariant `A[i] <= A[2i+1]` and `A[i] <= A[2i+2]`?
explanation: A valid binary min-heap must satisfy A[i] <= children for every parent. Bottom-up heapify rearranges `[95, 85, 75, 65, 55, 45, 35]` to `[35, 55, 45, 65, 85, 95, 75]`.
